event.description: Union closest block-0 pre-FF norm biases 6 and 1
event.proposal: Family: parameter tying. Current retained frontier is 1,481 parameters at 99.110000%, a +0.110000 percentage-point margin over 99%. There have been 82 prior macro-attempts in this family and 670 prior micro-trials. The most recent accepted result is attempt-0183/micro-0005 at 1481 parameters and 99.110000%; the most recent failed result is attempt-0184/micro-0001 (discard, 98.040000%). This is a parameterization-preserving compression of block 0's pre-feed-forward normalization biases: union coordinates 6 and 1, values -0.0590417981 and -0.0540862270 (difference 4.956e-03), using a weighted mean and integer reconstruction. Hypothesis: additive centering has local redundancy distinct from the measured scale boundary, preserving qualification at 1,480 parameters. It is more informative than the next bias union (difference 5.813e-03) because it is the minimum-distortion isolated bias test; scales remain fixed. Official acceptance and rollback are unchanged.
